name: SupabaseKong
description: Kong is the API gateway used by the official self-hosted Supabase Docker stack. It routes Studio, Auth, REST, GraphQL, Realtime, Storage, and Edge Functions through a single public endpoint.

paths.name: Kong Config
paths.description: Official Supabase Kong declarative config copied from supabase/docker/volumes/api/kong.yml.

paths.name: Kong Entrypoint
paths.description: Official Supabase Kong entrypoint copied from supabase/docker/volumes/api/kong-entrypoint.sh.

paths.name: TLS Certificate
paths.description: Optional TLS certificate for direct HTTPS on Kong. Usually a reverse proxy terminates TLS instead.

paths.name: TLS Private Key
paths.description: Optional TLS private key for direct HTTPS on Kong. Usually a reverse proxy terminates TLS instead.

ports.name: HTTP Gateway Port
ports.description: Supabase HTTP API gateway port. Container port: 8000.

ports.name: HTTPS Gateway Port
ports.description: Supabase HTTPS API gateway port. Container port: 8443. Mount TLS files and set Kong SSL variables if you enable direct TLS here.

variables.name: Database Mode
variables.description: Kong database mode. Supabase uses declarative DB-less config.

variables.name: Declarative Config Path
variables.description: Generated Kong config path inside the container.

variables.name: DNS Order
variables.description: Kong DNS resolution order used by the Supabase stack.

variables.name: DNS Not Found TTL
variables.description: Kong DNS negative cache TTL in seconds.

variables.name: Plugins
variables.description: Kong plugins required by the Supabase gateway config.

variables.name: Proxy Buffer Size
variables.description: Kong Nginx proxy buffer size used by the Supabase stack.

variables.name: Proxy Buffers
variables.description: Kong Nginx proxy buffers used by the Supabase stack.

variables.name: SSL Certificate Path
variables.description: Optional TLS certificate path inside the container, for example /home/kong/server.crt.

variables.name: SSL Key Path
variables.description: Optional TLS private key path inside the container, for example /home/kong/server.key.

variables.name: Anon Key
variables.description: Legacy anon API key generated for the Supabase stack.

variables.name: Service Role Key
variables.description: Legacy service role API key. Never expose this key to client-side code.

variables.name: Publishable Key
variables.description: Optional opaque publishable API key for newer self-hosted Supabase setups.

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Optional opaque secret API key for newer self-hosted Supabase setups. Never expose this key to client-side code.

variables.name: Anon Asymmetric Key
variables.description: Optional pre-signed asymmetric JWT API key for the anon role.

variables.name: Service Role Asymmetric Key
variables.description: Optional pre-signed asymmetric JWT API key for the service_role role.

variables.name: Dashboard Username
variables.description: Basic auth username for Supabase Studio through Kong.

variables.name: Dashboard Password
variables.description: Basic auth password for Supabase Studio through Kong. Set a secure password before first start.
